text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san, thank you so much for earlier~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The lights in the classroom went out all 
of a sudden, so it really gave me a 
fright! Is that what folks call a 
'surprise party'?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jumping over desks and chairs! City folks 
sure know how to celebrate birthdays in 
style~.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad... you liked it... We were 
worried... that we might have startled you 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You mean you didn't do this all 
by yourself, Cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I gotta thank that person 
too! I was just so downright touched!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... don't think they'll show 
themselves... ...But... they are always 
there... Right by... your side, 
Yukino-san...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~! Are ya shy? Ehehe, there's no 
need to be bashful!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you would, Cafe-san, please pass this 
along to 'em. Tell 'em it was a mighty fun 
party, and I'm truly grateful!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Such a warm... smile... ...No wonder... 
everyone adores her so much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... they'll be happy... ...Because 
they always wished... for your 
happiness...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... feel the exact same way... ...Happy 
birthday... May you have... a wonderful 
year...
